G=load()
from collections import deque
def find_block(g):
    bg=g[0][0]; H,W=len(g),len(g[0])
    seen=set(); best=None
    for r in range(H):
        for c in range(W):
            if g[r][c]!=bg and (r,c) not in seen:
                comp={(r,c)}; q=deque([(r,c)])
                while q:
                    a,b=q.popleft()
                    for da,db in ((1,0),(-1,0),(0,1),(0,-1)):
                        na,nb=a+da,b+db
                        if 0<=na<H and 0<=nb<W and g[na][nb]!=bg and (na,nb) not in comp: comp.add((na,nb)); q.append((na,nb))
                sc=len(comp)*len({g[a][b] for a,b in comp})
                if best is None or sc>best[0]: best=(sc,comp)
    comp=best[1]
    rngs=list(comp); rmin=min(a for a,b in rngs); rmax=max(a for a,b in rngs)
    cmin=min(b for a,b in rngs); cmax=max(b for a,b in rngs)
    return comp,rmin,rmax,cmin,cmax
i=G['Test input']; bg=i[0][0]
comp,rmin,rmax,cmin,cmax=find_block(i)
P=[[i[a][b] for b in range(cmin,cmax+1)] for a in range(rmin,rmax+1)]
h,w=len(P),len(P[0])
seeds=[(r,c) for r in range(len(i)) for c in range(len(i[0])) if i[r][c]!=bg and (r,c) not in comp]
print(P)
print('h,w',h,w,'center',(h-1)//2,(w-1)//2,'seeds',seeds)

import json
def analyze_pair(k):
    gi=G[k+' input']; go=G[k+' output']
    H,W=len(gi),len(gi[0]); bg=gi[0][0]
    seen=set(); comps=[]
    for r in range(H):
        for c in range(W):
            if gi[r][c]!=bg and (r,c) not in seen:
                comp={(r,c)}; q=deque([(r,c)])
                while q:
                    a,b=q.popleft()
                    for da,db in ((1,0),(-1,0),(0,1),(0,-1)):
                        na,nb=a+da,b+db
                        if 0<=na<H and 0<=nb<W and gi[na][nb]!=bg and (na,nb) not in comp: comp.add((na,nb)); q.append((na,nb))
                sc=len(comp)*len({gi[a][b] for a,b in comp})
                comps.append((-sc,comp))
    _,block=min(comps,key=lambda x:x[0])
    rngs=list(block); rmin,rmax,cmin,cmax=min(a for a,b in rngs),max(a for a,b in rngs),min(b for a,b in rngs),max(b for a,b in rngs)
    P=[[gi[r][c] for c in range(cmin,cmax+1)] for r in range(rmin,rmax+1)]
    h,w=len(P),len(P[0])
    seeds=[(r,c,gi[r][c]) for r in range(H) for c in range(W) if gi[r][c]!=bg and (r,c) not in block]
    # find each stamped copy: locate P patterns in go other than original
    offs=[]
    for r in range(H-h+1):
        for c in range(W-w+1):
            match=all(go[r+i][c+j]==P[i][j] for i in range(h) for j in range(w))
            if match and (r,c)!=(rmin,cmin):
                # determine which seed sits at top-left
                src=[(a - r, b - c, gi[a][b]) for a in range(rmin,rmax+1) for b in range(cmin,cmax+1) if False]
                near_seeds=[s for s in seeds if abs(s[0]-r)<=h and abs(s[1]-c)<=w]
                offs.append(((r-cmin if False else None,None),near_seeds))
    return P,(h,w),seeds,offs
for k in ['Demo pair 4','Demo pair 5','Demo pair 6']:
    P,hw,seeds,offs=analyze_pair(k)
    print(k,'shape',hw,'seeds',seeds[:12],'' ,'[x' + str(len(seeds)) + ']')
    print('  offsets (seed pos -> pattern top-left):')
    for off in offs: pass

def solve(g):
    H,W=len(g),len(g[0]); bg=g[0][0]
    bbs=comps(g,bg); big=max(bbs,key=len)
    rng=list(big); rmin=min(a for a,b in rng); rmax=max(a for a,b in rng)
    cmin=min(b for a,b in rng); cmax=max(b for a,b in rng)
    h,w=rmax-rmin+1,cmax-cmin+1
    ar,ac=(h-1)//2,(w-1)//2
    centr=rmin+ar; centc=cmin+ac
    P=[[g[a][b] for b in range(cmin,cmax+1)] for a in range(rmin,rmax+1)]
    blocks=set(big)
    out=[row[:] for row in g]
    for r,c in [(a,b) for a in range(H) for b in range(W) if g[a][b]!=bg and (a,b) not in blocks]:
        tr=r-centr; tco=c-centc
        for i in range(h):
            for j in range(w):
                rr,cc=tr+i,tco+j
                if 0<=rr<H and 0<=cc<W: out[rr][cc]=P[i][j]
    return out

def tiling_score(gi,go,h,w,P,rmin,cmin):
    H,W=len(go),len(go[0]); bg=gi[0][0]

    for r0 in range(h):
        for c0 in range(w):

def solve_color(g, target=None):
    H,W=len(g),len(g[0]); bg=g[0][0]
    bbs=comps(g,bg); big=max(bbs,key=len)
    rng=list(big); rmin=min(a for a,b in rng); rmax=max(a for a,b in rng)
    cmin=min(b for a,b in rng); cmax=max(b for a,b in rng)
    h,w=rmax-rmin+1,cmax-cmin+1
    P=[[g[a][b] for b in range(cmin,cmax+1)] for a in range(rmin,rmax+1)]
    bl=set(big)
    out=[row[:] for row in g]
    ctr=((h-1)//2,(w-1)//2)
    for r in range(H):
        for c in range(W):
            if g[r][c]!=bg and (r,c) not in bl:
                sc=g[r][c]
                hits=[(i,j) for i in range(h) for j in range(w) if P[i][j]==sc]
                if not hits: continue
                # choose occurrence closest to center, tie -> topmost-leftmost
                best=min(hits,key=lambda p:(abs(p[0]-ctr[0]),abs(p[1]-ctr[1]),p))
                for i in range(h):
                    for j in range(w):
                        rr,cc=r-(best[0]-ctr[0])+i,c-(best[1]-ctr[1])+j
                        if 0<=rr<H and 0<=cc<W: out[rr][cc]=P[i][j]
    return out

def solve_center(g, mode='seed', keep_block=True):
    H,W=len(g),len(g[0]); bg=g[0][0]
    bbs=comps(g,bg); big=max(bbs,key=len)
    rng=list(big); rmin=min(a for a,b in rng); rmax=max(a for a,b in rng)
    cmin=min(b for a,b in rng); cmax=max(b for a,b in rng)
    h,w=rmax-rmin+1,cmax-cmin+1
    P=[[g[a][b] for b in range(cmin,cmax+1)] for a in range(rmin,rmax+1)]
    bl=set(big)
    out=[row[:] for row in g]
    # seeds: non-bg cells not in the block bbox... but noise inside bbox is part of comp; use all cells outside big component itself
    seeds=[(r,c) for r in range(H) for c in range(W) if (r,c) not in bl]
    ctr=((h-1)//2,(w-1)//2)
    erase=None
    if mode=='erase':
        for r in range(H):
            for c in range(W):
                if (r,c) in bl: out[r][c]=bg
    for r,c in seeds:
        # skip if already painted? paint regardless; original block excluded via bl check
        for i in range(h):
            for j in range(w):
                rr,cc=r-ctr[0]+i,c-ctr[1]+j
                if 0<=rr<H and 0<=cc<W: out[rr][cc]=P[i][j]
    return out
for m in ['keep','erase']:
    ok=all(solve_center(G[f'Demo pair {n} input'],m)==G[f'Demo pair {n} output'] for n in range(1,9))
